aboutGame.title: What is Rocket Arena?
paragraphs: Rocket Arena is an explosive 3v3 hero shooter developed by Final Strike Games and published by Electronic Arts. Set in the vibrant world of Crater, players compete in fast-paced arena battles where traditional bullets are replaced by a diverse arsenal of rockets, abilities, and dynamic movement mechanics.

Instead of health bars and fatal headshots, Rocket Arena features an escalating Blast Meter system inspired by platform brawlers. Accumulate damage to launch rivals clean out of the arena with Megablasts, customize your champions with powerful artifacts, and master team-oriented game modes.

modules.description: Introduce all playable heroes with their unique rockets, abilities, playstyles, and customization options. Discover strengths and tactics for every champion in Crater.

highlights.detail: Hydro-powered skirmisher specializing in fast water torpedoes and high-mobility escape.

modules.name: rocketarena Beginner Guide
modules.description: Provide new player guidance covering basic controls, rocket combat mechanics, dodging, movement, aiming, and important beginner strategies.

highlights.detail: Learn Blast Meter thresholds from safe blue to danger red before facing opponents.
Master rocket jumping and air dodging to recover back onto the stage after hits.
Pick an accessible starter hero like Jayto or Amphora to practice projectile timing.
Lead your shots ahead of moving targets rather than aiming directly at current hitboxes.
Collect neutral item pickups across the map to gain shields, speed, or tactical bombs.
Coordinate with teammates to focus fire redlined targets for clean Megablast knockouts.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about Rocket Arena mechanics, heroes, and game modes.

items.question: What is Rocket Arena?
items.answer: Rocket Arena is a 3v3 hero-based shooter developed by Final Strike Games and published by Electronic Arts. Players battle in vibrant arenas using customizable champions armed with unique rocket launchers and abilities.

items.question: How does combat work in Rocket Arena?
items.answer: Rocket Arena replaces traditional health bars with a dynamic Blast Meter. Taking damage fills your meter, making you fly further when hit until a critical strike causes a Megablast knockout.

items.question: Which heroes are best for Rocket Arena beginners?
items.answer: Jayto and Amphora are the best starter choices in Rocket Arena due to their versatile weapons, straightforward abilities, and reliable aerial recovery tools.

items.question: What game modes are available in Rocket Arena?
items.answer: Rocket Arena includes competitive modes such as Knockout, Megarocket, Rocketball, and Treasure Hunt, along with cooperative Rocketbot Attack.

items.question: What are Artifacts in Rocket Arena?
items.answer: In Rocket Arena, Artifacts are pre-match loadout items that grant passive combat advantages like blast damage reduction, faster movement, or quicker dodge cooldowns.
